mapper.sql: id, create_time, update_time, bool_delete_enum, version, path, bool_last_enum, level, parent_id, name, material_type, code
mapper.update: UPDATE wms_classification wc SET wc.classify_update_status = 3 WHERE id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT ( sapd.classify_id ) FROM scm_apply_purchase_detail sapd LEFT JOIN scm_apply_purchase sap ON sap.id = sapd.apply_purchase_id AND sap.bool_delete_enum = 0 );

UPDATE wms_classification wc SET wc.classify_update_status = 3 WHERE id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT ( spod.classify_id ) FROM scm_purchase_order_detail spod LEFT JOIN scm_purchase_order spo ON spo.id = spod.purchase_id AND spo.bool_delete_enum = 0 );

UPDATE wms_classification wc SET wc.classify_update_status = 3 WHERE id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT ( wid.classify_id ) FROM wms_inbound_detail wid LEFT JOIN wms_inbound wi ON wi.id = wid.inbound_id AND wi.bool_delete_enum = 0 );
UPDATE wms_classification wc JOIN wms_classification wc1 ON wc.id = wc1.parent_id SET wc.classify_update_status = 2 WHERE wc.classify_update_status = 1 AND wc1.classify_update_status IN ( 3, 2 );
mapper.select: SELECT wc.* FROM wms_classification wc JOIN wms_measure wm ON wc.id = wm.classification_id AND wm.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE wc.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND wc.bool_last_enum = 1 AND wc.basic_class = #{basicClass} AND wm.accounting_unit = #{unit}
